title: Home Purchase Financing — Principal Paydown on a Home in a Pending In-Place Home Sale
content:
**Resale coordination desk reference — the sale paydown on a Home Purchase Financing loan**

## What it is

A borrower selling the financed home through a Hearthstone Home Sales resale file may pay down the loan principal before closing so that the sale proceeds will cover the payoff; the sale paydown is the borrower's own extra payment designated to principal, made on a loan that is current. A sale paydown is applied to principal only, as a curtailment; fees owed stay on the payoff and are paid from the sale proceeds at closing.

## Working out the paydown

The principal paydown for a pending sale is not worked out until the loan carries a payoff statement issued on the paydown date.

That is, the paydown rests on a payoff statement dated the same day as the paydown, as the loan's notices show it.

## The borrower's own action: `make_principal_paydown_1606199b`

**Capability.** The borrower pays down the principal of their own Hearthstone Home Finance loan by phone from their bank account: a one-time phone ACH payment designated to principal. It is recorded today as an extra principal payment that lowers the loan's unpaid principal by the amount paid; it does not move the next installment's due date and is not applied to fees.

**How it is invoked.** This is the borrower's own tool. The agent unlocks `make_principal_paydown_1606199b` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it to authorize the payment.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `loan_id` | the loan number of the borrower's Hearthstone Home Finance loan, as the agent reads it from the loan record | identifier |
| `amount` | the principal payment, as the agent tells it to the borrower | USD, a positive amount with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** On success: `status` "received", `loan_txn_id` (reference of the principal payment), `payment_ref` (the payment confirmation number to keep), `loan_id`, `txn_date` (today, YYYY-MM-DD), `amount` (USD, 2 decimal places), `payment_channel` ("phone_ach") and `principal_balance` (USD, 2 decimal places, unpaid principal after the payment).
